category: market and fundamentals data API (financial statements, ratios, valuation, stock prices, earnings call transcripts)

free_tier.stated: Free plan USD 0/month: 5 requests per minute and 2 years of history, with every endpoint and all public companies included; plans differ only by rate limit and history depth.
free_tier.notes: A request for history beyond 2 years answers HTTP 403 naming the minimum plan that covers it, and a request over the minute limit answers HTTP 429 with Retry-After and X-RateLimit headers. The pricing comparison table lists batch stock prices and the earnings calendar as not included on Free, while the authentication page and the changelog of 4 June 2026 say every endpoint is available; most per-endpoint pages still carry the line Free tier: AAPL available on free tier, and the ticker list page says Free tier: Premium only. The next plan up is Individual at USD 24 a month billed annually, with 300 requests a minute and 5 years of history.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-response cap is stated on the pages read; period endpoints return 10 periods by default and take a limit parameter

retention.stated: 2 years of history on the Free plan; a request for older data answers HTTP 403
retention.notes: A query API with no stored objects.

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 5 requests per minute bound what a free key can pull

interface_detail: GET https://api.roic.ai/v2/{endpoint} with the key in the apikey query parameter; JSON by default or tab-separated values with format=excel. An MCP server at https://mcp.roic.ai/mcp exposes the same data as tools, and two spreadsheet endpoints serve an Excel and Google Sheets add-on.
tooling: any HTTP client; request examples for cURL, Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Go and Google Sheets; an MCP server
chaining: Worldwide fundamentals, ratios, prices and earnings call transcripts for the last 2 years at 5 requests a minute, with no daily or monthly count stated; deeper history, higher rates and bulk downloads are paid, so a free stack pairs it with a quote feed such as Finnhub or Alpha Vantage.

limits.value: 5 requests per minute on the Free plan; over it the API answers HTTP 429

limits_note: History depth: 2 years on Free, and a request beyond it answers HTTP 403. Bulk path: none on Free; bulk downloads are listed for Professional and Enterprise.
binding_note: 5 requests a minute is the only rate cap stated for the Free plan; the 2-year history depth bounds each series.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page takes an email and a password, or Google sign-in; the quickstart says the free tier needs no credit card.

reliability_note: Over the minute limit the API answers HTTP 429 with Retry-After and X-RateLimit headers; a call with no key answered HTTP 401 Invalid or missing API key.
confidence_note: The Free plan limits are read from the first-party authentication page, the changelog and the pricing page, and a keyless call answered HTTP 401. The pricing table and the per-endpoint pages disagree with the authentication page on which endpoints the Free plan reaches, and a free key was not exercised, so that point is unverified: behind a sign-up.
